      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --success: #059669;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius: 10px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
    }

    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Header */
    .site-header {
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
    }

    .header-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 14px 0;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo span { color: var(--charcoal); }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .header-actions a { color: var(--gray-700); transition: color 0.2s; }
    .header-actions a:hover { color: var(--primary); }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px 22px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-300);
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }

    /* Nav */
    .main-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
      padding-bottom: 12px;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      padding: 6px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-item:hover { color: var(--primary); }

    .nav-item svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-item.active svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .mega-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: -20px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      min-width: 520px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      z-index: 1001;
    }

    .mega-menu.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .mega-menu-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 10px 28px;
    }

    .mega-menu a {
      display: block;
      padding: 6px 0;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }

    .mega-menu a:hover { color: var(--primary); }

    .mega-menu-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    /* Ticker */
    .ticker-bar {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 10px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .ticker-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 60px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      animation: ticker-scroll 20s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }

    .ticker-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

    .ticker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .ticker-item svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    @keyframes ticker-scroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light) 0%, var(--white) 60%);
      padding: 56px 0 48px;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: 2.6rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }

    .hero-visual {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 36px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .challenge-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
      color: var(--white);
      width: 140px;
      height: 140px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .challenge-badge .day-num {
      font-size: 2.4rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .challenge-badge .day-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .challenge-title {
      margin-top: 20px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    /* Trending */
    .trending {
      padding: 40px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .trending-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .trending-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .trending-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary-light);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .trending-card .cat {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .trending-card h3 {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    /* Newsletter CTA */
    .newsletter-cta {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F4C5C 0%, var(--primary) 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 56px 0;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .newsletter-cta h2 {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .newsletter-cta p {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      opacity: 0.9;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      max-width: 480px;
      margin: 0 auto 12px;
    }

    .newsletter-form input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: none;
      font-size: 1rem;
      outline: none;
    }

    .newsletter-form input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-500); }

    .privacy-note {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }

    /* Health Topics */
    .health-topics {
      padding: 48px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .topics-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .topics-scroll {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .topics-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      padding: 8px 4px 20px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .topics-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .topic-card {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .topic-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }

    .topic-card .img-wrap {
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0 auto 12px;
      border: 3px solid var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .topic-card .img-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .topic-card span {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .scroll-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 10;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .scroll-btn:hover { background: var(--primary-light); border-color: var(--primary); }

    .scroll-btn.prev { left: 0; }
    .scroll-btn.next { right: 0; }

    .scroll-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--gray-700); }

    /* Tools */
    .tools-section {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .tool-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .tool-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .tool-card > p {
      color: var(--gray-700);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .tool-list {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .tool-list li {
      padding: 10px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .tool-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .tool-list .tool-name {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .tool-list .tool-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .tool-list a {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary);
      white-space: nowrap;
      margin-left: 12px;
    }

    .tool-list a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    .tool-cta {
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    /* Recommended Reads */
    .recommended-reads {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .tab-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tab-btn {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-300);
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-700);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }

    .tab-btn.active {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--primary);
    }

    .article-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .article-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .article-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .article-card .thumb {
      height: 160px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), #D1E7E9);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.5rem;
    }

    .article-card .info { padding: 18px; }

    .article-card h4 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    /* Trust Section */
    .trust-section {
      padding: 64px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .trust-section h2 {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .trust-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .trust-card {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 28px 20px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .trust-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .trust-icon {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      background: var(--primary-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .trust-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    .trust-card h4 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .trust-card p {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Featured Programs */
    .featured-programs {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary-light) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
    }

    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .program-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: all 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .program-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .program-card .prog-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--primary-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .program-card h4 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.35;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    /* Latest Videos */
    .latest-videos {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .videos-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .video-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3c40, var(--primary-dark));
    }

    .video-card .play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .video-card:hover .play-btn { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.08); }

    .video-card .play-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--primary); margin-left: 3px; }

    .video-card .video-title {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      padding: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.7));
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--charcoal);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      padding: 56px 0 28px;
    }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: start;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .footer-newsletter h3 {
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .footer-newsletter p {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .footer-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .footer-form input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 11px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      outline: none;
    }

    .footer-form input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-500); }

    .footer-links {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px 20px;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }

    .footer-links a {
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-800);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 700px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-social a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-visual { order: -1; max-width: 320px; margin: 0 auto; }
      .trending-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .article-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .main-nav { display: none; }
      .trending-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .article-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: 2rem; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
    }

    /* Utility */
    .view-all {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .view-all:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    .hidden { display: none !important; }
  </style>

The WellSource homepage has been built and all output files are in `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

### Key Features Implemented

11. **Footer** — Newsletter signup, link columns, legal disclaimer, and social links.

- **Palette**: Teal primary (#02838D), coral accent (#E8734A) for CTAs, warm whites/grays for backgrounds — calming and health-oriented.

- **Responsive**: Fully responsive grid layouts that stack on mobile; nav hides on small screens.
- **SEO**: Complete `<head>` with meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, canonical URL, Organization + WebSite JSON-LD structured data, favicon placeholders, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml.
